title: A Survey on Evaluation of Out-of-Distribution Generalization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as a form of subpopulation shift and spurious correlation within datasets (e.g., CelebA, CivilComments, UCI Adult). The survey highlights methodologies such as measuring worst-group performance on minority demographic groups and using Shapley values to attribute the driving factors behind performance disparities (e.g., income prediction differences between men and women).

Assessed as a subpopulation distribution shift using demographic attributes in benchmark datasets (e.g., CelebA, CivilComments, UCI Adult). The primary evaluation methodology reviewed involves calculating worst-class or worst-group accuracy to measure generalization performance when minority racial groups dominate the test data.
